title: OKR Dependency Forecast and Commitment Lanes
creator: Maya Patel
description: Problem: Company-level initiatives are frequently blocked or de-scoped late in the quarter due to untracked cross-team dependencies and ambiguous resource commitments. Objective: Produce an operational playbook and lightweight tooling to forecast dependency risk against company OKRs and create explicit commitment lanes (green/amber/red) tied to resourcing bands and rollback criteria. Approach: 1) Build a probabilistic dependency forecast model (inputs: owner confidence, lead time, cycle load, historical unblock time) to compute a per-initiative confidence score and risk exposure. 2) Define three commitment lanes with explicit triggers for escalation and rollback. 3) Integrate forecast outputs into the quarterly roadmap dashboard and the cadence (weekly OKR sync) so PMs and Eng leads can act early. 4) Publish playbook, update intake templates, and run a pilot with Product, Eng, Design, and Infra teams for Q2 planning.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Forecast model produces a per-initiative confidence_score (0-100) and risk_exposure metric for all company-level initiatives with >0.5 historical coverage
A2: Every company-level initiative is assigned a commitment_lane (green|amber|red) and documented resourcing band in the intake template
A3: Rollback/escalation rules documented and tested in tabletop exercise with at least 3 scenarios
A4: Dashboard shows dependency forecast and lane for each initiative and is visible to execs and leads
A5: Pilot feedback collected from 4 participating teams and at least 3 concrete changes to intake or cadence are committed
A6: Decision log created and linked; adoption plan scheduled for next planning cycle
tasks: T1: Draft forecasting model spec and input schema (owner: Data PM)
T2: Wireframe dashboard view and lane visualization (owner: Design)
T3: Implement prototype model in a Colab and run on last 6 quarters of initiatives (owner: Analytics)
T4: Update initiative intake template to capture confidence and hard blockers (owner: PM Ops)
T5: Define lane triggers and rollback thresholds with Eng leadership (owner: Eng PM)
T6: Build dashboard integration (owner: Eng infra) and expose read links to execs
T7: Run pilot tabletop exercises and collect structured feedback (owner: Program Manager)
T8: Publish playbook in Confluence and communicate at company planning all-hands

2026-03-02 — Priya Nair (Eng): Eng concern: autoscaling and Dedicated capacity dependencies are not currently represented in initiative metadata. ENG-1842 will add a 'capacity footprint' field to intake. Blocking until that merges.

2026-03-08 — Alex Chen (Analytics): Prototype run on last 6 quarters shows model calibration is reasonable; median confidence reduction aligns with historical de-scopes. Need better owner-confidence normalization.
2026-03-12 — Ethan Rivera: Updated scope after sync: MVP = model + dashboard + playbook + 1 pilot cycle. Added rollback thresholds to acceptance criteria and scheduled tabletop on 2026-03-25.
decisions: D1: Use a probabilistic model with owner-reported confidence and historic unblock-time priors rather than a binary blocked flag
D2: Commitment lanes will be tied to resourcing bands (0.25 FTE, 0.5 FTE, 1.0+ FTE) and mapped to green/amber/red semantics
D3: Exec escalation only required when initiative moves from green->red within a 2-week window or when risk_exposure > 0.7
